prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins (such as in rounds 3, 4, and 6).
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (2 winning tests in rounds 4 and 6), though 9 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each; finish new_screen changes mostly showed no clear effect (4 tests).
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Command Guide Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding guide screen right after home intro demonstrating how to control, move, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Three support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Render Activity Mascot Companion Flow: Adds an interactive companion mascot tips flow with an active timer during the rendering waiting step. (why: Home rendering wait times are extremely long (201s median, 2336s mean), causing users to abandon the app.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Recovery Banner Hint: Displays a hint on the sign_in screen reassuring returning users that logging in restores all existing pet data automatically. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Render Stage Live Activity Status Tracker: Enables step counters, progress bar, and active time estimates on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: Home wait times average 2336s and 3 emails reported app stalling or pet not displaying.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Welcome Callout Headline Copy: Updates home_intro headline and body copy explaining where the pet appears on screen and how to unhide it. (why: Multiple support emails noted confusion over finding and controlling the pet after onboarding completes.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Quality Hint: Adds an informational hint on upload_photos screen outlining optimal lighting and pose guidelines for pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or distorted render outputs.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Spawning Complete Alert Notification: Triggers a notification prompt on the render waiting screen so users get alerted when rendering finishes. (why: Mean waiting duration is 2336s, leading users to switch windows and miss completion.)

scores.note: Adding new screens to finish step consistently shows negative or neutral results (-2.6%).
New flow changes across steps are consistently harmful to conversion.
Sign-in hints have strong evidence (top support issue) and proven historical success.
Home wait_info changes are a proven winning category across 4 earlier rounds.
Finish copy changes have shown no clear positive effect historically (-1.8%).
Targets the highest drop step (33.8% loss) at low cost, though hint pattern has limited historical data.
Home notifications showed modest positive trend (+0.6%) but no clear effect across tests.
